title: Pre Vocational and Vocational Training for People with Mental Health Needs
description: The service will provide a Pre-Vocational and Vocational Mental Health Day Service for people with mental health needs across Cardiff and the Vale of Glamorgan. The service will support recovery, social inclusion and independence through vocational and avocational training, skills development, peer support, wellbeing activities, volunteering opportunities, and pathways into employment, education and community participation. The service will provide a supportive and rehabilitative environment to help individuals develop confidence, practical skills and opportunities for progression. The services are intended to be provided from 1st April 2027 to 30th September 2030 for an initial period of 3.5 years, with the option to extend for a further 12 months until 30th September 2031.

title: Fællesregionalt udbud efter ultralydsudstyr
description: Dette udbud er efter rammeaftaler på ultralydsudstyr til alle kliniske specialer. Der efterspørges udstyr i to kvalitetsklasser, Guld og Sølv. Udbuddet er et fælleudbud, med forpligtende deltagelse fra de fem regioner, samt option på deltagelse fra Grønland og Færøerne. Der er 14 delaftaler, fordelt på 7 specialer og 2 kvalitetsklasser. Det indgås parallelle rammeaftaler med 3-4 vindere i hver delaftale, indplaceret i en prioriteret rækkefølge. Aftræk vil ske fra 1. vinderen, medmindre der er konkrete kliniske grunde til at vælge en af de efterstående vindere. En Tilbudsgiver kan tilbyde og vinde placeringer i flere delaftaler, men kun byde med en apparat konfiguration til hver af de 14 delaftaler.

title: Germany – Facade work – Neubau Volkstheater Rostock, Am Bussebart, 18055 Rostock - Los 308 Fassaden
description: Auf dem Baufeld zwischen "Lange Straße", "Am Kanonsberg" und dem Parkplatz "Am Bussebart" in Rostock lässt der Auftraggeber den Neubau des Volkstheaters Rostock errichten. Der Standort des geplanten Theaters befindet sich innerhalb des historischen Stadtkerns nahe der ehemaligen Stadtmauer / Kröpeliner Tor. Benachbart liegt das städtebaulich markante „Haus der Schifffahrt“, das im Jahr 1962 fertiggestellt worden ist. Der Theater-Neubau ist als Stahlbetonbau geplant; teilweise kommen aber auch Stahl- und Verbundträger/-stützen zur Ausführung. Der Lastabtrag erfolgt teilweise über wandartige Träger und Flachdecken in Ortbeton. Der Theater-Neubau ist als 4-Sparten-Theater mit einem Großen Saal (ca. 650 Sitzplätze), einer Raumbühne (ca. 200 Sitzplätze) sowie zwei großen und zwei kleinen Probebühnen konzipiert. Darüber hinaus werden im Theater-Neubau noch Räumlichkeiten für öffentliche Gastronomie in den Ebenen E3 und E7 angeboten. Das Theater verfügt über drei Untergeschosse; in der untersten Ebene (E-3) wird eine öffentliche Tiefgarage mit ca. 100 Kfz-Stellplätzen vorgesehen. Die Zu- und Ausfahrtsrampe ist auf der Nordseite zum Parkplatz "Am Bussebart" angeordnet. Auch die Ver- und Entsorgungsanfahrt liegt auf der Nordseite des Theater-Neubaus.

Premium- ja Design-lahjat Tilaaja perehtyy puitejärjestelyyn valittujen toimittajien tuotevalikoimiin ja päättää, mistä tuotteista Vantaan kaupungin premium- ja design-lahjat koostuvat. Mikäli useammalla valitulla toimittajalla on valikoimassaan sama tuote tai tilaajan tarpeen täyttävä vastaava tuote, tilaaja kilpailuttaa tuotteet rivikohtaisesti käyttäen puitejärjestelyn sisäistä kilpailutusta (kevennetty kilpailutus). Halvimman hinnan antanut toimittaja valikoituu kyseisen tuotteen toimittajaksi. Mikäli tilaajan valitsema tuote on saatavilla ainoastaan yhden puitejärjestelyyn valitun toimittajan valikoimassa, voidaan tuote hankkia kyseiseltä toimittajalta ilman puitejärjestelyn sisäistä kilpailutusta. Valitut tuotteet brändätään tilaajan ohjeiden mukaisesti, ja niiden tulee olla ladattavissa tilaajan sähköiseen tilausjärjestelmään. b. Kaikki valikoiman ulkopuoliset muut tuotteet Valikoiman ulkopuolisella tuotteella tarkoitetaan tuotetta, jota ei ole tilaajan sähköisessä tilausjärjestelmässä tai erikseen määritetyssä vakiovalikoimassa. Kaikki muut valikoiman ulkopuoliset tuotteet tilataan noudattaen puitejärjestelyä seuraavasti: Enintään 8000 euron (alv 0 %) arvoiset tilaukset Tilaaja ja tilaajan toimialat, voivat tehdä arvonlisäverottomalta arvoltaan enintään 8000 euron arvoisia tilauksia hankintatarpeen kannalta soveltuvimmalta puitejärjestelyyn valitulta toimittajalta. Tilaus voidaan tällöin tehdä suoraan yhdeltä puitejärjestelyyn valitulta toimittajalta. Valinnassa voidaan huomioida hankintatarpeeseen liittyvät tekijät, kuten tuotteen ominaisuudet, saatavuus, toimitusaika, ympäristö- ja vastuullisuusominaisuudet sekä kokonaistaloudellinen edullisuus. Tilaaja voi halutessaan pyytää tarjouksia myös useammalta puitejärjestelyyn valitulta toimittajalta, jolloin noudatetaan samoja sääntöjä, kuin yli 8000 euron tilausten osalta. Yli 8000 euron (alv 0 %) arvoiset tilaukset Arvonlisäverottomalta arvoltaan yli 8000 euron arvoisissa tilauksissa Tilaajan tulee määrittää hankintatarpeensa ja kilpailuttaa puitejärjestelyyn valitut toimittajat käyttäen kevennettyä kilpailutusta. Kevennetty kilpailutus järjestetään niiden toimittajien välillä, jotka hankintapäätöksen mukaisesti on valittu toimittajiksi puitejärjestelyyn, ja jotka voivat toteuttaa Tilaajan määrittelemän tilaustarpeen, ottaen huomioon tilauksen kohteeseen liittyvät vaatimukset. Tilaaja ilmoittaa tapauskohtaisesti kevennetyn kilpailutuksen tarjouspyynnössä käytettävät vertailuperusteet ja niiden painoarvot. Kevennetyssä kilpailutuksessa arviointiperusteina voidaan ottaa huomioon esimerkiksi tuotteen ominaisuudet, saatavuus, toimitusaika, ympäristö- ja vastuullisuusominaisuudet sekä kokonaistaloudellinen edullisuus. Kevennetyn kilpailutuksen vaiheet: - Tilaaja määrittelee tarvitsemansa tuotteen/tuotteet ja laatii hintatiedustelun. Hintatiedustelusta voivat ilmetä mm. ehdottomat vaatimukset ja tarjousten vertailukriteerit. - Tilaaja lähettää hintatiedustelun samanaikaisesti sähköisesti puitejärjestelyyn valituille toimittajille. - Puitejärjestelyyn valittu toimittaja lähettää tarjouksensa hintatiedustelussa määritellyn ajan puitteissa. Tarjouksessa tulee noudattaa puitejärjestelyn ja sen sisäisen kevennetyn kilpailutuksen ehtoja. - Tilaaja valitsee saapuneista tarjouksista parhaan noudattaen hintatiedustelussa ilmoittamiaan kriteereitä. - Tilaaja tiedottaa tilauspäätöksestä sähköpostitse kaikille tarjouksen jättäneille tarjoajille. - Tilaaja dokumentoi ja arkistoi materiaalin asiakirjahallintajärjestelmään. Tilaus tehdään päätöksenteon jälkeen suoraan toimittajalta puitejärjestelyssä ja sen sisäisessä kevennetyssä kilpailutuksessa määriteltyjen sääntöjen ja ehtojen mukaisesti. Tilaaja tekee lopullisen tilauksen oman sähköisen tilausjärjestelmän kautta valitulle toimittajalle. Tilaaja päättää tilauskohtaisesti, mikäli tuotteet tulee brändätä sekä ladata tilaajan sähköiseen tilausjärjestelmään.,

title: Interiér kavárny v objektu čp. 23/12, Mírové náměstí, Bílina
description: Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je dodávka kompletního interiérového vybavení kavárny (moderního stravovacího provozu) v souladu s projektovou dokumentací „KAVÁRNA U ČERNÉHO KONĚ – BÍLINA - část gastronomická“ na adrese Mírové nám. 23/12, Bílina, 418 01, v katastrálním území Bílina [604208], parc. č. 124. Součástí veřejné zakázky jsou také lokální bourací práce, doplnění nových povrchových úprav, montáž atypických truhlářských výrobků, realizace akustických prvků, nové osvětlení a příprava prostoru pro gastro technologii v souladu s projektovou dokumentací „Kavárna v domě Černý kůň“. Zadavatel upozorňuje, že prostory kavárny se nacházejí ve stejném podlaží, jako je již funkční infocentrum města. Celkový rozsah plnění této veřejné zakázky je stanoven zadávací dokumentací a veškerými jejími přílohami, zejména Projektovou dokumentací včetně výkazu výměr (Příloha č. 2a a 2b ZD) a Závazným návrhem smlouvy (Příloha č. 3 ZD).

title: Oprava topného systému Základní škola Aléská, Bílina
description: Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je rekonstrukce teplovodních rozvodů vytápění včetně výměny stávajících litinových článkových otopných těles za nová desková otopná tělesa v objektu základní školy na adrese Aléská 270, 418 01 Bílina, v katastrálním území Bílina [604208], na pozemku parc. č. 336/44. Stavebním záměrem se nemění kapacity, prostorové uspořádání ani účel užívání objektu. Součástí plnění je také třídění, odvoz a řádné předání všech odpadů vzniklých při provádění díla oprávněné osobě v souladu s právními předpisy. Kovový odpad předá Zhotovitel oprávněnému zařízení ke sběru nebo výkupu kovových odpadů. Výnos z výkupu kovového odpadu náleží Objednateli. Zhotovitel je povinen předat Objednateli bez zbytečného odkladu doklad o množství a ceně vykoupeného kovového odpadu a vyplatit Objednateli dosažený výnos v souladu se Závazným návrhem smlouvy. Součástí předmětu plnění je rovněž demontáž a likvidace stávajících zařízení, dodávka a montáž nových rozvodů a otopných těles, napuštění a odvzdušnění systému, provedení předepsaných tlakových a funkčních zkoušek, případné seřízení a vyregulování systému, uvedení systému do provozu a předání veškeré dokumentace o provedených zkouškách a revizích. Celkový rozsah plnění této veřejné zakázky je stanoven zadávací dokumentací a veškerými jejími přílohami, zejména Projektovou dokumentací včetně výkazu výměr (Příloha č. 2 ZD) a Závazným návrhem smlouvy (Příloha č. 3 ZD).

title: Část I.: Modernizace odborných učeben ZŠ Za Chlumem – Stavební úpravy - opakované zadání
description: Předmětem části I. veřejné zakázky je kompletní realizace díla, tj. stavebních prací, souvisejících dodávek a dalších činností realizovaných dle technického popisu plnění a výkazů výměr. Dílem se rozumí realizace akcí s názvem „Odborné učebny v objektu ZŠ Za Chlumem 824, Bílina“ a „ZŠ Za Chlumem, PD zdvihacího zařízení včetně stavby (přístavba osobního výtahu)“. Jedná se o stavební úpravy uvnitř objektu v souladu s projektovými dokumentacemi, které jsou Přílohou č. 2 této ZD. Součástí této Přílohy č. 2 jsou rovněž zpracované výkazy výměr. Stavebními úpravami nedojde ke změně z hlediska účelu a způsobu užívání dokončené stavby. Stavba je členěna stavebními úpravami na čtyři samostatné učebny (učebna informatiky, multimediální učebna, učebna jazyků a kabinet a učebna a laboratoř chemie) a výtah. Zadavatel požaduje, aby veškeré stavební práce, související dodávky a další činnosti byly realizovány v souladu s cíli a zásadami udržitelného rozvoje a zásadou „významně nepoškozovat“ (Do no significant harm, dále jen „DNSH“) v oblasti životního prostředí. Bližší podmínky těchto požadavků jsou uvedeny v závazném návrhu Smlouvy, která tvoří Přílohu č. 3 této ZD. Součástí předmětu plnění je také zajištění kompletního vytyčení inženýrských sítí, zvláštní užívání komunikace, dopravně inženýrské opatření a všechny související a neopominutelné požadavky, jsou-li pro zdárnou realizaci díla potřebné. Tyto činnosti si kompletně na vlastní náklady zajistí vybraný dodavatel. Dodavatel bude povinen v rámci plnění Smlouvy předložit rovněž ES prohlášení o shodě na výtah jako celek dle nařízení vlády č. 122/2016 Sb. a směrnice Evropského parlamentu a Rady 2014/33/EU a označení CE Předmět plnění veřejné zakázky je současně vymezen závazným návrhem Smlouvy, která tvoří Přílohu č. 3 ZD.

title: MH-65E Digital Video Recorder (DVR) System
description: This is a solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with (IAW) the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) subpart 12.201 as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 70Z03826QE0000034 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ). This solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect as of November 28, 2025, IAW the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO). The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 334310. The small business size standard is 750 employees. This solicitation is an unrestricted requirement. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which shall be considered by the agency. The USCG requires a Digital Video Recorder (DVR) System for the MH-65E airframe. The DVR requirements can be found in Attachment 1 � Schedule of Supplies and Attachment 2 � Statement of Work (SOW). Interested parties must complete Attachment 1 � Schedule of Supplies and submit as part of the quotation. All items shall be NEW approved items. It is anticipated that one (1) Indefinite Delivery Requirements type contract with firm-fixed pricing (FFP), consisting of one (1), one (1) year Base Period and, if exercised, four (4) one (1) year Option Periods will be awarded as a result of this synopsis/solicitation. The total duration of this contract shall not exceed five (5) years. FFP Delivery Orders will be issued against the contract as items are required. The list of items and estimated quantities can be found on Attachment 1 - Schedule of Supplies. The items on Attachment 1 � Schedule of Supplies � Base Period are subject to First Article Testing IAW FAR clause 52.209-4. SCHEDULE OF SUPPLIES **Must fill out Attachment 1: Schedule of Supplies. Failure to completely fill out Attachment 1 shall result in the quote not being considered** The contractor shall furnish a Certificate of Conformance (COC) IAW FAR clause 52.246-15. The COC must be submitted in the format specified in the clause. NOTE: NO DRAWINGS, SPECIFICATIONS, OR SCHEMATICS ARE AVAILABLE FROM THE USCG. Please carefully review this solicitation�s attachments for additional information and requirements such as applicable clauses and instructions to offerors: 1. Attachment 1 � Schedule of Supplies 2. Attachment 2 � Statement of Work (SOW) 3. Attachment 3 � Terms and Conditions 4. Attachment 4 � Test and Evaluation Plan The closing date and time for receipt of offers is 04 January 2027 at 10:00 A.M. Eastern Time. All Questions regarding this solicitation must be submitted in writing no later than five (5) business days prior to the solicitation closing date, 28 December 2026. Questions received after this deadline will not be answered. Anticipated award date is on or about 03 February 2026. Email quotations are preferred and may be sent to Adam.A.Finnell2@uscg.mil. Please indicate 70Z03826QE0000034 in the subject line.

title: Y1DA--561-24-600 Upgrade Mechanical Systems-C Level
description: This notice is for Solicitation Number 36C24226R0127, Project Number 561-22-600 Upgrade Mechanical Systems-C Level at the VA NJ Health Care System, East Orange, NJ. This shall be a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside. As a result, all SDVOSB's may submit an offer, which will be considered by the agency. This project is classified under NAICS Code 238220 and has a size standard of $19 Million. The Magnitude of Construction for this project is between $5,000,000 and $10,000,000. Scope of Work: The scope of work shall generally consist of, but not limited to the following: Project will renovate the existing C Level utility space located at C Level of Building 1 which will provide environmentally safe, comfortable, and compliant conditions for maintenance staff. The current HVAC equipment and plumbing systems are in poor condition causing continuous water & steam leakage. The improper function of pumps is leaving the pump-pit filled with water. Newly renovated space will optimize daily activities, routine maintenance of utilities and provide safe environment for maintenance staff at C Level at VA New Jersey Health Care System East Orange Campus. Contractor shall completely prepare site for building operations, including demolition and removal of existing structures, and furnish labor and materials to perform work for VA Project 561-24-600 Upgrade Mechanical Systems-C Level as required by AE drawings and specifications, including but are not limited to: Steam Header Replacement and Distribution Condensate & Steam Piping Modification and Replacement of PRVs, Hangers & Valves Architectural and Structural Modification to Condensate Pump Pit Modification to Supply & Exhaust Air and Repair of Outside Air Intakes Hazardous Material Remediation and Insulation Repair Mechanical Room Drainage Enhancement Improvement of Lighting and Electrical Panels Refinish Surfaces, Removal of Brine Residue, Overall System Tagging/Identification and Systems Monitoring, Safety & Security. The contractor shall also furnish all labor, materials, tool, and supervision necessary to perform work for VA Project 561-22-600 Upgrade Mechanical Systems C-Level, in accordance with AE drawings and specifications. Project Completion: 430 Calendar Days from Notice to Proceed (NTP). All other details and information shall be contained in the solicitation which shall be posted on www.sam.gov. The solicitation will be released on or about November 23, 2026. The response submittal address, date and time will be included in the solicitation. This project requires bonding and all responses/submissions to the solicitation to be posted later shall be emailed. No hand-carried bids will be accepted. All prospective bidders must be currently registered in www.sam.gov , and be registered and verified as a Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) in https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ at the time of offer submission and before award of this procurement. End of Description.

title: RFB to Lease the Joshua Brooks House
description: Summary of the Opportunity This Request for Bids (RFB) provides the opportunity for interested individuals and organizations to submit bids to the National Park Service (NPS) to lease NPS property for residential use (single family) at Minute Man National Historical Park under the following general terms and conditions. See attached �Draft Lease� for complete terms of occupancy. Property Offered for Lease Joshua Brooks House The Joshua Brooks House is located at 41 North Great Road, Lincoln, MA 01773. It is approximately 2,216 SF with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. It was built by Deacon Joshua Brooks circa 1780 and is situated on an approximately 0.75-acre site. The Joshua Brooks House has been completely renovated with an attached carriage house which could be used for a small car or bikes and kayaks. The first floor is spacious with a redesigned kitchen including new stainless-steel appliances, cabinetry and quartzite counter tops. The newly refinished floors reflect the natural light from meticulously restored windows. The first-floor full bathroom was recently renovated, and a new smart washer and dryer have been installed in the nearby mudroom. Two stairways lead to the second floor where there is a dedicated office, 3 bedrooms, and another recently renovated full bathroom. The house features a restored terraced seating patio overlooking Elm Brook and surrounding forest and active agricultural fields. Uses of the Leased Property This lease is most suitable for low-impact, non-transient, residential occupancy of the house. The lessee is authorized to use the property as an occupant of the house and must be willing to become a part of the National Historical Park�s relationship with the public by maintaining the historic and well-tended appearance of the structure and grounds. In accordance with the attached draft lease, the lessee is responsible for all utilities and routine maintenance. The lessor will perform basic maintenance of the property as described in the lease. Term of Lease The lease will have a maximum term of three years, and a minimum term of one year. Lessee termination rights (termination without cause) will begin 90 days before the end of the first year of the lease and continue until the lease expires. Please note: 90 days� notice is required for termination without cause. Fair Market Value Rent The lessee will be required by the lease to pay at least fair market value rent to the NPS. Based on the terms included in the attached Lease (Section 5. Rent), the minimum fair market value rent has been determined to be $54,000 annually, payable in equal monthly installments of $4,500 each month. The lessee shall pay to the United States as rent the sum of Fifty-Four Thousand Dollars ($54,000.00) per year as the base rent payable to the National Park Service and forwarded by the lessee to the Superintendent, Minute Man National Historical Park. Rent checks will be mailed to Minute Man National Historical Park, 174 Liberty Street Concord, MA 01742, attention Superintendent. The annual rent shall be paid on the 1st day of each month in advance monthly installments of Four-Thousand Five-Hundred Dollars ($4,500.00). Payment covering the first month will be submitted with the executed lease. Other Terms and Conditions None. Competitive Process This lease opportunity is open to all interested persons on a competitive basis. The bidder submitting a responsive bid offering the highest monthly rent will be selected for award of the lease (subject to a determination of financial capability and reference check). A responsive bid is a bid that meets the material terms and conditions of this request for bids (see attached lease terms). The bid must offer a rental amount that is no less than fair market value as stated above. If two or more bids are equal, a drawing shall make the lease award by lot limited to the equal responsive bids received. Initial and Rolling Bid Submissions Bids must be received by the date listed on the first page of this RFB and must be submitted electronically in the format provided on the following pages. A public bid opening will occur the next day after the Initial Bid Submission Deadline (or the following Monday if the deadline is on a Friday). If a winning bid is not selected on that date, the NPS will open bids every following Monday at 1:00 PM until a responsive bid has been submitted or until NPS terminates the solicitation. Authority This RFB is issued under the authority of federal law and regulations. The applicable law is found in United States Code at 54 USC 1021 and leasing regulations may be found in the Code of Federal Regulations at 36 CFR Part 18. This RFB and the offered lease are subject to and incorporate all terms and conditions of Part 18 as applicable. In the event of any conflict between the terms of this RFB and Part 18, Part 18 controls. For Further Information Please Contact: Mike McCarthy Administrative Officer Minute Man National Historical Park 174 Liberty Street Concord, MA 01742 Phone: (781) 472-0970 E-mail: mike_mccarthy@nps.gov NPS reserves the right at any time and in NPS� sole discretion, to cause or do any or all of the following: Waive or correct any defect or technical error as to form or content of this RFB or in any bid, response, proposal, or proposal procedure, as part of the RFB or any subsequent selection and negotiation process. Modify, amend, cancel, or suspend any and all aspects of the RFB and selection process. Reissue an RFB. Modify the scope of the Lease or the required responses or modify the components of the Lease. Request that Respondents clarify, supplement, or modify the information submitted. Extend deadlines for accepting RFB responses, or request amendments to responses after expiration of deadlines. Consider comparable projects owned, developed, or operated by a Respondent. The National Park Service and Minute Man National Historical Park The National Park Service and its Mission America�s National Park Service was created by Congress to �conserve the scenery and the natural and historic objects and the wildlife therein, and to provide for the enjoyment of the same in such a manner and by such means as will leave them unimpaired for the enjoyment of future generations.� Additionally, the Congress has declared that the National Park System should be, �� preserved and managed for the benefit and inspiration of all the people of the United States.� The National Park Service has as its overall mission the preservation and public enjoyment of significant aspects of the nation�s natural and cultural heritage. To learn more about the National Park Service, visit our website at www.nps.gov. This site includes information about who we are, our mission, NPS policies and individual parks. Minute Man National Historical Park Minute Man National Historical Park was created by an Act of Congress on September 21, 1959 �� to preserve for the benefit of the American people certain historic structures and properties of outstanding national significance associated with the opening of the War of the American Revolution�� The specific purposes of the park include: �� the preservation of the historic landscape along the road between Lexington and Concord, (2) sites associated with the causes and consequences of the American Revolution, and (3) the Wayside on Lexington Road in Concord �.� To learn more about Minute Man NHP visit our website at: https://www.nps.gov/mima/index.htm. title: 2027 Construction Inspection Services Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC)
description: Federal Highway Administration Eastern Federal Lands Highway Division Construction Inspection and Management Support Services (MATOC) Solicitation No. 693C73-27-R-000006 The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), Eastern Federal Lands Highway Division (EFLHD), anticipates awarding up to four Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts for construction inspection and other professional engineering services for the administration, oversight, and design of construction contracts performed by EFLHD on behalf of various Federal Land Management Agencies (FLMAs). These agencies include the National Park Service, the U.S. Forest Service, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, and the Bureau of Land Management within the continental United States and its territories. This acquisition will be solicited and awarded on a competitive basis and is being made under the North America Industry Classification Code 541330 via full and open competition with small business reserves, per FAR 19.112. Two of the four anticipated IDIQ contracts will be reserved for small business concerns, if qualified. The planned duration for each of the IDIQ contracts is a total of five years (one base year plus four option years). The shared capacity of the IDIQs will be $60,000,000. In support of onsite construction activities, the types of work the Architectural-Engineer (A-E) firms may be required to perform under this MATOC include but are not limited to: inspection and documentation of construction activities; monitoring contractor compliance with plans, specifications, and contract requirements; review of contractor submittals; coordination of materials inspection and testing; monitoring of safety and environmental compliance; preparation of daily reports and progress documentation; schedule monitoring; and other related construction inspection and engineering support services. Construction projects supported under these contracts may include roadway construction and rehabilitation; bridge repair or replacement; drainage improvements; erosion and sediment control measures; traffic control; signage installation; safety improvements; and other transportation-related infrastructure improvements. The REQUEST FOR QUALIFICATIONS (RFQ) - PHASE I should be issued on or about November 20, 2026. The due date for receipt of Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) will be specified in the RFQ. IMPORTANT SAM REGISTRATION AND PAYMENT REQUIREMENTS: In accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 52.204-7 (DEVIATION NOV 2025), prospective contractors shall have an active Federal Government contracts registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) when submitting an offer in response to a solicitation and at the time of award. To register in SAM, go to https://www.sam.gov. Annual contractor representations and certifications must be completed online at https://www.sam.gov. Also, FAR 52.232-33 requires SAM registration for payment. It is the Offerors' responsibility to check the Internet address provided as necessary for any posted changes to this pre-solicitation, the future RFQ solicitation, and/or amendments.

title: RFI - FEMA - Supply Chain Management System (SCMS)
description: FEMA�s Logistics Management Directorate, Logistics Systems Division, is conducting market research to identify commercially available cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions and associated services to transition, implement, operate, maintain, modernize, and support the FEMA Supply Chain Management System (SCMS). The anticipated requirement supports disaster logistics operations, including order and inventory management; warehouse and transportation operations; asset and in-transit visibility; point-of-distribution support; supply-chain reporting; procurement and enterprise resource planning interfaces; and financial reconciliation. FEMA is seeking solutions capable of supporting routine operations and scalable disaster-response surge requirements. The anticipated scope may include transition and implementation services, configuration and integration, recurring SaaS licensing, operations and maintenance, help desk and technical support, cybersecurity and system authorization support, continuity of operations, training, reporting, and optional surge capacity. FEMA anticipates a cloud-based solution or service model with approved system-to-system interfaces and applicable security, privacy, accessibility, and safeguarding requirements. This is a Request for Information (RFI) issued solely for market research and acquisition-planning purposes. It is not a solicitation, request for proposal, request for quotation, or commitment by the Government. No contract will be awarded from this RFI. title: Solicitation Notice: Repair of the F-15 Digital Mapping System (DMS) Advanced Display Core Processor (ADCP)
description: Title: Solicitation - Repair of the F-15 Digital Mapping System (DMS) Advanced Display Core Processor (ADCP) NAICS: 811210 PSC/FSC: J016 Notice ID: FA8538-27-R-B004 The 409th Supply Chain Management Squadron (SCMS) / GUMA anticipates a five-year, Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Indefinite Delivery Contract (IDC) for the repair of the F-15 Advanced Display Core Processor (ADCP), NSN: 1270-01-562-6566FX, PN: 8525470-951 and Digital Map Processor (DMP), NSN: 5895-01-444-5142FX, PN: 8520305-911 to provide all the necessary parts and labor to test and repair the ADCP/DMP. The repair of the ADCP/ DMP is performed as a Direct Sales Partnership Agreement (DSPA) with the Government (WR-ALC/EMXG), supporting requirements generated for the Air Force Sustainment Center (AFSC), 638th Supply Chain Management Group (SCMG), 409th Supply Chain Management Squadron (SCMS)/GUMCA.The anticipated IDC will include one (1) 12-month basic year and four (4) one-year ordering periods. The proposed contract action is for services for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate using Other Than Full and Open Competition (OTF&OC) procedures in accordance with RFO Part 6.103-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. The Government does not own any production level technical data or specialized test equipment in support of this requirement. As a result, Honeywell International Inc. (CAGE 07187), is the only known source with adequate knowledge of the F-15 Digital Mapping System (DMS) Advanced Display Core Processor (ADCP) performance requirements and possession of the required technical data and capabilities needed to repair this item and ensure compatibility of the equipment. The Government's required delivery schedule is 21 days after receipt of asset. The quantities shown below represent the Best Estimated Quantities for this effort. title: Greece – Road construction works – Βελτίωση ασφάλειας τμήματος εθνικής οδού από Μυρσινίδι έως Μιλιγκά
description: Η περιοχή των προβλεπόμενων έργων αποτελεί τμήμα της Εθνικής Οδού Χίου-Καρδαμύλων και συγκεκριμένα στο οδικό τμήμα από Μυρσινίδι μέχρι την περιοχή ελιγμών βορειότερα του λατομείου Μιλιγκά, μεταξύ των Χ.Θ. 0+084.20 και Χ.Θ. 2+702.56. Η έναρξη της χιλιομέτρησης τοποθετείται στην Ι.Μ. Μυρσινιδίου, περί τις συντεταγμένες Χ: 686642.29 και Υ: 4255333.01 σε ΕΓΣΑ '87. Η περιοχή των προβλεπόμενων έργων διαχωρίζεται στις περιοχές Ο1, Ο2, Κ1, Κ2, Ο3, Κ3, Ο7, Ο4, Ο5 και Ο6, κατά σειρά αύξουσας χιλιομέτρησης. Σκοπός τoυ έργου είναι η βελτίωση ασφάλειας τμήματος εθνικής οδού από Μυρσινίδι έως Μιλιγκά, μέσα από σειρά εργασιών που προβλέπονται στο πλαίσιο των εγκεκριμένων μελετών και είναι οι εξής: 1. Χωματουργικές εργασίες και εργασίες οδοστρωσίας που περιλαμβάνουν: - Εκσκαφές χαλαρών εδαφών - Γενικές εκσκαφές σε έδαφος γαιώδες – ημιβραχώδες - Γενικές εκσκαφές σε έδαφος βραχώδες με και χωρίς χρήση εκρηκτικών - Εκσκαφές θεμελίων τεχνικών έργων - Καθαίρεση οπλισμένων σκυροδεμάτων - Απομάκρυνση επισφαλών βραχωδών όγκων με και χωρίς συνεργείο αναρριχητών - Κατασκευή επιχωμάτων - Επένδυση πρανών με φυτική γη - Κατασκευή επιχωμάτων από κοκκώδη υλικά σε πεζοδρόμια και θέσεις τεχνικών - Κατασκευή μεταβατικών επιχωμάτων τεχνικών έργων - Απόξεση ασφαλτικών οδοστρώματος και στρώσεων οδοστρωσίας - Κατασκευή στρώσεων οδοστρωσίας, ασφαλτικών στρώσεων και ερεισμάτων 2. Εργασίες μείωσης επικινδυνότητας έναντι βραχοπτώσεων που περιλαμβάνουν: - Τοποθέτηση πλήρως αγκυρούμενων ενισχυμένων με συρματόσχοινα συρματοπλεγμάτων - Εγκατάσταση φραχτών ανάσχεσης βραχοπτώσεων - Τοποθέτηση αγκυρίων ολόσωμης πάκτωσης - Εγκατάσταση συστήματος προειδοποίησης βραχοπτώσεων - Κατασκευή τοίχων από συρματοκιβώτια 3. Κατασκευές από σκυρόδεμα που περιλαμβάνουν: - Μικροκατασκευές καναλιών, εξομαλυντικών στρώσεων κλπ - Κατασκευή φρεατοπασσάλων και κεφαλόδεσμων εξ' οπλισμένου σκυροδέματος - Κατασκευή τοίχων αντιστήριξης εξ' οπλισμένου σκυροδέματος - Κατασκευή σωληνωτών οχετών από προκατασκευασμένους τσιμεντοσωλήνες - Κατασκευή φρεατίων και πτερυγότοιχων εξ' οπλισμένου σκυροδέματος 4. Στεγανώσεις και κατασκευή αρμών Τεχνικών έργων που περιλαμβάνουν: - Εργασίες επεξεργασίας επιφανειών σκυροδέματος - μονώσεις – σφράγιση αρμών 5. Αποστραγγίσεις που περιλαμβάνουν: - Κατασκευή φίλτρων αποστράγγισης από κατάλληλα διαβαθμισμένα θραυστά αδρανή - Τοποθέτηση γεωυφασμάτων στραγγιστηρίων και διαχωρισμού - Εγκατάσταση διάτρητων τσιμεντοσωλήνων στραγγιστηρίων 6. title: RFI - Mesh Knit Cloth Manufacturability
description: SYNOPSIS: This Sources Sought Announcement is to assist the US Army DEVCOM Soldier Center to identify potential sources to provide a Mesh Knit Cloth conforming to MC-PD-25-006, Rev 2, dated 19 November 2026. The Government requests that responses be submitted electronically to Trevor Scott, trevor.h.scott.civ@army.mil, and Jennifer Fernald, jennifer.l.fernald.civ@army.mil, by January 4th, 2027 by 5pm EST. Background: The Government (DEVCOM Soldier Center) is interested in implementing potential updates to the current mesh knit cloth used in the USMC Cold Weather (CW) Baselayers conforming to MIL-DTL-32740, and MIL-DTL-32741. The purpose of this RFI is to gather industry feedback regarding the ability to meet the requirements listed in MC-PD-25-006, Rev 2, to ensure manufacturability prior to applying specification updates. Description: Mesh knit cloth material updates include increased material stretch, weight, thickness, and aperture size. title: Sentinel Re-Entry Vehicle Facility (RSRV) Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) Project
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Los Angeles District (SPL) is issuing a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) for an FY27 Construction Management At Risk (CMAR) Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) for military construction to qualified and interested CMAR Teams to participate in the delivery of the Sentinel Re-Entry Vehicle Facility (RSRV) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB) in Santa Barbara County, California. CMAR Teams may submit a White Paper as the first step in a competitive, two-step selection process. The CMAR team will be selected based on proven past performance, credentials of key personnel, and collaborative capabilities rather than a price proposal. The selected CMAR Teams will facilitate early, open-book collaboration with the Government, its design Architect-Engineer of Record (A-E DOR), and Air Force stakeholders to reconcile design packages, optimize constructability, and validate weapon system requirements. The Government will evaluate White Papers based on the criteria identified in this announcement using a qualifications-based, collaborative evaluation process. The evaluation is intended to identify the CMAR Team best suited to partner with the Government to further develop the project scope, technical solution, and agreement terms during subsequent phases of the process. The Department of the Air Force and Air Force Global Strike Command require the construction of a new Sentinel Re-Entry Vehicle Facility (RSRV) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB) to support critical Ground Based Strategic Deterrent (GBSD) developmental and operational testing while preserving the active Minuteman III test launch schedule. This project will deliver a highly complex, explosive-sited vertical defense facility featuring a primary 1,152 SM payload handling building equipped with specialized heavy crane and mechanical systems, secure spaces built to Intelligence Community Directive 705 (ICD-705) standards, a 743 SM shop/surveillance area, and a 427 SM munitions maintenance administration space to support a 22-person missile maintenance crew. The NAICS code for this procurement is 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The procurement instrument is Other Transaction (OT) Agreement utilizing Construction Management at Risk (CMAR). Phase 1 will be for pre-construction services. Phase 2 may be added by modification for construction upon successful negotiation of a Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) subject to authorization, approvals, and availability of funds. The estimated program amount of this acquisition is $110,000,000.00. The RFQ is available through the Solicitation Module of the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) suite at https://piee.eb.mil/. For instructions on how to post White Papers, please refer to the Posting Offer demo: https://pieetraining.eb.mil/wbt/sol/Posting_Offer.pdf. Additional information is available via Web Based Training for the Solicitation Module at: https://pieetraining.eb.mil/wbt/xhtml/wbt/sol/solicitation/proposals.xhtml. Attachment 2: Draft STEP 2: Invitation for Pitch Presentation (Applicable only to Offerors invited to proceed to Step 2 and may be revised prior to final issuance). Attachment 3: Draft Model OT Agreement. Attachment 4: DIV 0001 Specs *NOTE: Attachment 2 will only be provided to the CMAR Team selected to participate in pitch presentations. **NOTE: Attachments 3 and 4 will be provided upon request and disclosure of CAGE code to be accessed through the PIEE Solicitation Module. title: Sustaining PNT & Integrating with Development to Enhance Readiness (SPIDER)
description: This Request for Information (RFI) / Sources Sought Synopsis is issued by Space Systems Command (SSC) to determine the market capabilities of potential offerors to execute the contemplated Sustaining Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) & Integrating with Development to Enhance Readiness (SPIDER) contract. The Space Force has committed to sustaining and modernizing the existing, proven Global Positioning System (GPS) ground segment for the foreseeable future. The SPIDER contract is the anticipated long-term successor to the current GPS Control Segment Sustainment II (GCS II) contract. SPIDER represents a paradigm shift from pure hardware and software sustainment to a unified sustainment and continuous development integration model. The contractor must not only sustain the legacy ground systems but also continuously integrate developmental modifications from ongoing modernization efforts to support next-generation spacecraft and rapidly field critical warfighter capabilities. Please see attached PA-2336 Cleared SPIDER Request for Information for more.

title: Invitation to Industry: FIRES Threat Coordination Group on Adversarial Threats to Offensive Fires
description: The Headquarters Department of the Army (HQDA), Deputy Chief of Staff (DCS) G-2, invites eligible, cleared U.S. industry partners to participate in an in-person, classified Fires Threat Coordination Group (TCG) in Charlottesville, Virginia, from February 16�18, 2027. This engagement facilitates a classified, two-way dialogue between Government intelligence analysts and industry partners regarding emerging adversarial threats to offensive fires portfolios. Discussions will inform capability development, modernization priorities, threat modeling, and counter-UAS (C-UAS)/counterfire considerations in contested environments. title: Germany – Geotechnical engineering services – Geotechnische Fremdprüfung und Beratungsleistungen
description: Gemäß Hamburger Senatsbeschluss gelten seit 2012 neue Bemessungswasserstände für öffentliche Hochwasserschutzanlagen in Hamburg, die eine Anpassung aller HWS- Anlagen zur Folge haben. Die Deichabschnitte Cranzer und Neuenfelder Hauptdeich im Hamburger Bezirk Harburg sollen auf einer Gesamtlänge von insgesamt ca. 3,2 km (DKM 30,343 bis DKM 33,628) an die aktuellen Sollhöhen für den Hochwasserschutz angepasst werden. Die erforderliche Erhöhung der Deiche um im etwa 60 cm bis 80 cm, unter Beibehaltung der vorhandenen Böschungsneigungen der Deiche von 1:3, hat eine Verbreiterung des Deichquerschnitts zur Folge. Es ist geplant, die Verbreiterung vorwiegend binnenseitig umzusetzen, so dass die vorhandenen wasserwirtschaftlichen Einrichtungen, d.h. Entwässerungsgräben, Dränagen etc., verlegt bzw. umgebaut werden müssen. Wegen der erforderlichen Deichhöhenanpassung bzw. der resultierenden binnenseitigen Verbreiterung der Deichquerschnitte wird es zudem erforderlich, die südlich des Bestanddeiches verlaufende Deichverteidigungsstraße, die auch dem öffentlichen Verkehr gewidmet ist, zu verlegen und in diesem Zuge an die aktuellen Regelbauweisen anzupassen. Zur Schaffung der neuen Deichverteidigungsstraße wird der Bestandsgraben verfüllt. Über den zu überbauenden Bestandsgraben wird ein Auflastkörper zur beschleunigten Konsolidierung errichtet. In Kombination dazu werden auf ca. 11.000 m² Vertikal-Dränagen angeordnet. Zur Überwachung des Porendrucks werden Porenwasserdruckgeber angeordnet. Setzungen werden mit Setzungspegeln überwacht. Das Projektgebiet wird durch die Este in ein Teilabschnitt Neuenfelde und Cranz getrennt. Für beide Abschnitte wird ein eigenes Planfeststellungsverfahren notwendig. Baustart für den Abschnitt Neuenfelde ist für 2028 geplant. Die Planung sieht vor, dass in Cranz ein Jahr später als in Neuenfelde gebaut wird. Das Projekt befindet sich in Neuenfelde in der Lph 05 und in Cranz in der Lph 03. Die zu vergebenden Leistungen gliedern sich in übergeordnete Leistungen sowie vier voneinander unabhängige optionale Leistungsblöcke. Die optionalen Leistungsblöcke können vom Auftraggeber einzeln und unabhängig voneinander abgerufen werden. Ein Anspruch des Auftragnehmers auf den Abruf einzelner, mehrerer oder sämtlicher optionaler Leistungsblöcke besteht nicht. Aus dem Abruf eines Leistungsblocks ergibt sich kein Anspruch auf den Abruf weiterer Leistungsblöcke. Die übergeordneten Leistungen beziehen sich auf beide Projektgebiete, Neuenfelde und Cranz. Einarbeitung: - Einarbeitung in geotechnische Berichte und sonstige relevante Unterlagen beider Projektgebiete Genehmigungsplanung Cranz: - Gutachterliche Betreuung der Genehmigungsplanung für das Projektgebiet Cranz - Durchführung der erforderlichen geotechnischen Nachweise und Berechnungen, insbesondere erdstatischer Berechnungen, Standsicherheitsberechnungen und Konsolidationsberechnungen - Erstellung von Berichten und Dokumentationen zu den durchgeführten Nachweisen und Berechnungen Option 1: Begleitung der Bauausführung Neuenfelde: - Verifizierung und Validierung sowie erforderlichenfalls Fortschreibung des vorhandenen Qualitätssicherungsplans (QSP) für Neuenfelde - Durchführung baubegleitender Fremdprüfungen, insbesondere beim Einbau von Klei- und Deichkernmaterial, Auflastkörpern, Arbeitsebenen sowie bei Grabenverfüllungen und im Straßen- und Wegebau, einschließlich des dazugehörigen Berichtswesens - description: Es handelt sich nicht um ein offenes Verfahren, sondern um ein sog. open-house-Modell! Das Formular für das offene Verfahren wird lediglich deshalb verwandt, da kein Formular für das open-house-Modell existiert. Verträge, die im open-house-Modell geschlossen werden, unterfallen mangels Auswahlentscheidung nicht dem Vergaberecht. Eine Unterwerfung unter vergaberechtliche Regelungen ist mit der Verwendung dieses Formulars nicht verbunden. Die AOK Bayern beabsichtigt, mit allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen nicht-exklusive Rabattvereinbarungen über den Wirkstoff Nilotinib, ATC L01EA03 (ausgeschlossen Nilotinib dispergiert in Apfelmus, es sei denn, der Hersteller genießt hierfür Patentschutz), nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zu schließen. Die AOK Bayern bietet allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, die die unten genannten Eignungsvoraussetzungen erfüllen, den Abschluss identischer und nicht individuell verhandelbarer Rabattvereinbarungen an. Der frühestmögliche Vertragsbeginn ist der 01.03.2025, alle Verträge enden am 28.02.2027. Ein Vertragsschluss ist während dieser Laufzeit jederzeit möglich, spätestens jedoch am 05.01.2027. Die Verträge können mit einer Frist von einem Monat zum Monatsende gekündigt werden. Bei Inkrafttreten eines durch bundesweite oder landesspezifische, im offenen Verfahren geschlossenen Rabattvertrags über Arzneimittel mit dem auftragsgegenständlichen Wirkstoff treten die open-house-Vereinbarungen automatisch für die entsprechende Laufzeit außer Kraft. Ein Vertrag wird mit allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen geschlossen, die ihre Eignung durch eine ausgefüllte und unterschriebene Eigenerklärung zur Zuverlässigkeit nachweisen. Der pharmazeutische Unternehmer hat den ausgefüllten und unterzeichneten (die Vertretungsberechtigung des/der Unterzeichner/s muss sich aus dem Handelsregisterauszug ergeben, anderenfalls ist eine Vollmacht vorzulegen) Vertrag nebst ausgefüllter und unterzeichneter Anlage "Festlegung der vertragsgegenständlichen Arzneimittel" sowie die ausgefüllte und unterzeichnete Eigenerklärung zur Zuverlässigkeit einzureichen. Die Unterlagen können ENTWEDER in SCHRIFTFORM von Hand unterzeichnet ODER ELEKTRONISCH mit einer qualifizierten elektronischen Signatur eingereicht werden. Von Hand unterzeichnete Unterlagen in SCHRIFTFORM sind in 2-facher Fassung im Original an folgende Adresse einzusenden: AOK Bayern - Die Gesundheitskasse Vergabestelle SGB V ZE25 open-house Rabattverträge Carl-Wery-Str. 28 81739 München ELEKTRONISCHE Unterlagen mit einer qualifizierten elektronischen Signatur sind über den Kommunikationsbereich im Vergabeportal www.dtvp.de einzureichen. Bei Eingang vollständiger und korrekter Unterlagen bis zum 05. eines jeden Monats erfolgt der Vertragsbeginn zum darauf folgenden nächsten Monatsersten, ansonsten zum darauf folgenden übernächsten Monatsersten. Bei von Hand unterzeichneten Unterlagen in SCHRIFTFORM ist eine Übersendung der vollständigen, ausgefüllten und unterzeichneten Unterlagen vorab per Fax (089/62730650151), als Scan an die E-Mail-Adresse vergabestelle1@by.aok.de oder über den Kommunikationsbereich im Vergabeportal www.dtvp.de fristwahrend, wenn die vollständigen und korrekten Originalunterlagen in Papierform bis zum 10. des Monats bei der AOK Bayern, Vergabestelle, eingehen. Bitte beachten Sie die Ausfüllanleitung, die unter www.dtvp.de bei den Vergabeunterlagen zur Verfügung gestellt wird. Interessierte pharmazeutische Unternehmen können im Projektraum zum Open-House-Verfahren auf dem Portal www.dtvp.de die Freischaltung der Vergabeunterlagen beantragen. Ein Link zum Portal befindet sich in dieser Bekanntmachung. Als potentielle Vertragspartner kommen ausschließlich pharmazeutische Unternehmen in Betracht. Die Unterlagen des Open-House-Verfahrens werden ausschließlich pharmazeutischen Unternehmen als potentiellen Vertragspartnern freigeschalten und sind streng vertraulich zu behandeln. title: Ente Regional de la Energía de Castilla y León
description: 1.- Relación de las obras ejecutadas en el curso de los 5 últimos años, avalada por certificados de buena ejecución (art 88.1.a) de la Ley 9/2017. Estos certificados indicarán el importe, fechas y lugar de ejecución de las obras y se indicará si se realizaron según las reglas por las que se rige la profesión y se llevaron normalmente a buen término; en su caso, dichos certificados serán comunicados directamente al órgano de contratación por la autoridad competente. En todo caso se exige que entre las obras ejecutadas se hayan realizado al menos 3 instalaciones FVA de al menos 80 kW de potencia nominal cada una. Dicha exigencia se encuentra directamente vinculada al objeto del contrato y se establece al amparo de los art. 74 y 88 de la LCSP, al ser un medio adecuado para acreditar la solvencia técnica necesaria para la correcta ejecución de las prestaciones contratadas. Esto permite verificar que el licitador dispone de experiencia previa en la ejecución de instalaciones FVA de entidad y complejidad técnica comparables a las que constituyen el objeto del contrato. Asimismo, la exigencia de haber ejecutado al menos 3 instalaciones de estas características acredita una experiencia suficiente y consolidada en este tipo de actuaciones. Se considera, por tanto, un requisito adecuado, necesario y proporcionado a la naturaleza, características y complejidad de las prestaciones objeto del contrato, sin que suponga una restricción injustificada de la concurrencia. 2.- Indicación del personal o unidades técnicas, integradas o no en la empresa, de los que disponga para la ejecución del contrato (art. 88.1.b) y, como mínimo, un jefe de obra con una titulación equivalente a Ingeniero, Ingeniero técnico o Graduado en Ingeniería. La acreditación de estos extremos, se hará conforme a lo establecido en la cláusula 1.6.3. de este PCAP. De acuerdo con el art. 88.2 de la LCSP, las empresas de nueva creación (antigüedad inferior a cinco años), podrán acreditar su solvencia técnica a través del medio previsto en este apartado, relativo a los medios personales mínimos exigidos y de conformidad con el art. 88.1.b).

description: The examiner shall carry out a socio-economic analysis of alternative models for any rule management of the VAT compensation scheme (the VAT compensation scheme) for voluntary organisations in accordance with the Review Instructions and DFØ ́s guideline in socio-economic analyses the analysis shall highlight the benefit, costs and distribution impacts for the state, NGOs and society as a whole, as well as assess consequences for goal achievement, administrative load, control needs and budgetary risk. The Norwegian Parliament has made a decision on governing the VAT compensation scheme. The current scheme is statutory, based on the Norwegian Parliament ́s annual budget resolutions. In order to fulfil the rule management decision, the financing must be altered from the current framework-controlled grant to an estimate grant. The grant regulations approved by the Norwegian Parliament state that an estimate grant must be pursuant to the rules set by the Storting, cf. § 5 second section no. 1. This means that the scheme must be anchored in law. The government is following up the Storting's decision by examining the basis for and the consequences of any statutory scheme. A rule management of the VAT compensation scheme involves a fundamental change in the management mechanism for the scheme. The grant schemes are normally based on the rights of the individual. The VAT compensation scheme, on the other hand, assumes that the organisations annually apply for compensation, based on the total operational costs with some deductions. More than 90 percent of the recipients in the scheme receive funding based on a calculation model and not actual VAT costs (simplified model). In a simplified model, the operational costs can include wages and other costs without VAT. This means that in the current scheme, some organisations can receive more compensation than they have in actual VAT costs, while others may receive less in compensation than they have in VAT costs. title: Netherlands – Collection agency services – Inning Invordering Bezwaar en Beroep
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europeesopenbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Opdracht Een van de taken van de gemeente is handhaving op parkeren. De gemeente Breda voert deze handhaving in eigen beheer uit. Daarbij worden sinds 2019 scanauto’s ingezet. Hierbij worden naheffingsaanslagen uitgeschreven. Deze naheffingen dienen geïnd te worden. Deze uitvraag betreft de oplegging en inning/invordering van de door de gemeente uitgeschreven naheffingsaanslagen voor zowel Nederlandse als buitenlandse kentekens. Verder kan er bezwaar gemaakt worden tegen deze naheffingen. De afhandeling van deze bezwaarschriften en de afhandeling van eventuele daarop volgende beroepschriften vormen eveneens onderdeel van deze opdracht. Ter indicatie zijn hierbij de cijfers van 2025. Het betreft de volgende aantallen NHA’s: 132.968 NHA's De indicatie van de verwachte aantallen is ontleend aan de huidige situatie. Benadrukt wordt dat de omvang een indicatie is waaraan geen rechten ontleend kunnen worden. De werkelijke omvang van de opdracht kan dus in positieve of negatieve zin afwijken van de genoemde indicatie. Een doelmatige periodieke rapportage van de uitgevoerde activiteiten behoort eveneens tot de scope. De gemeente verwacht van de te contracteren partij dat ingespeeld wordt op nieuwe ontwikkelingen en wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving. Deze partij communiceert bijvoorbeeld proactief wanneer invordering in meerdere/nieuwe landen mogelijk wordt. De te contracteren partij verstuurt de NHA’s, waarbij de vormgeving in samenwerking met de gemeente tot stand komt, o.a. dat op de uitgeschreven NHA’s verwezen naar de uitvoerende partij voor de bezwaarmogelijkheden, dit dient in tekst en d.m.v. een QR duidelijk te worden. De gemeente zorgt ervoor dat op haar website verwezen wordt naar de bezwaarmogelijkheden bij opdrachtnemer. De gemeente is op zoek naar een partij die een snelle en efficiënte afhandeling van de invorderingsdossiers en bezwarencases kan borgen, waarbij klantvriendelijkheid hoog in het vaandel staat. Wetende dat niemand ‘blij’ wordt van een naheffing, is juist bij de klantcontacten een klantvriendelijke en waar nodig de-escalerende benadering voor de gemeente van belang. De gemeente Breda is momenteel bezig met het opstellen van een wielklembeleid. Momenteel is de gemeente bezig met de eerste onderzoekende fase. Het is mogelijk dat tijdens het contract of net voor het vastleggen van het contract meer informatie beschikbaar is over het invoeren van het wielklembeleid. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen: Doel Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om voor de levering van deze diensten een raamovereenkomst te sluiten. De overeenkomst treedt in werking op 1 december 2026 en heeft een looptijd van twee (2) jaar na het moment van livegang op 1 maart 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft bij wederzijds goedvinden van partijen het recht deze twee (2) maal met één (1) jaar te verlengen. De besluitvorming ten aanzien van deze verlenging(en) geschiedt op basis van evaluatie van de geleverde prestatie. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze raamovereenkomst wordt gesteld op € 5.000.000,- bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mocht gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst de maximale opdrachtwaarde worden overschreden dan zal de raamovereenkomst (eerder) worden beëindigd. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

title: Norway – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – PCR/ NAAT based microbiological rapid diagnostics for Helse Bergen HF
description: The objective of the procurement is to obtain quick testing equipment for microbiological PCR/NAAT analyses. The procurement is divided into two sub-contracts, connected to different types of tests. Sub-contract 1: PCR based quick diagnostics for Inf. A/B, RSV and SARS-CoV-2 Microbiological Department at Haukeland University Hospital request tenders for cassette based, random-access PCR diagnostics for Influenza A/B, RSV and Sars-CoV2. The tender is for analysing cassettes with the accompanying relevant instrumentation. Intended use: Detection of Influenza virus A-RNA, Influenza virus B-RNA, SARS-CoV-2-RNA and RSV-RNA Option for Helse Førde HF: The sub-contract includes an option for the delivery of equivalent quick testing equipment. Sub-contract 2: PCR or NAAT based quick diagnostics for detecting genetic resistance markers the Microbiological Department at Haukeland University Hospital would like tenders for cassette based, random-access NAAT diagnostics for quick detection of relevant resistance mechanisms from positive blood culture bottles. As gentamicin is an essential component of the empirical sepsis treatment in Norway, it is a requirement that the equipment detects the most common resistance mechanism for gentamicinreisintens in Enterobacterales in Norway (gene aac(3)-II). It is also necessary that the most common resistance mechanisms for ESBL (CTX-M groups 1 and 9) can be detected. In addition the test shall be used for quick clarification of relevant resistance mechanisms from bacteria colonies, mecA/mecC in Staphylococcus aureus, vanA/vanB in Enterococcus faecalis and E. faecium, as well as for clarification of the plasmid media AmpC in E. coli (minimum CMY-2 and DHA). The agreement also includes an option for the procurement of a further equivalent main product. General information: The stated consumption and scope are estimates for information to the tenderer and are not binding for future contract volume. The agreement includes options on service agreements, additional equipment, training of users and technical medical personnel for each sub-contract and an option for Helse Førde HF. Tenderers are also requested to submit tenders for equipment dependent consumables for the equipment. The prices shall be filled in Annex 1 - Price Form, in the tab "Equipment dependent consumables", based on the stated estimated annual test volumes. Note that the maximum value of the framework agreement can be up to 50% of the estimated consumption of consumables over the equipment ́s lifetime. See Annex 1 - Requirement Specification and Annex 2 - Price Form for further details on each sub-contract.

description: Special Notice Proliferated Low Earth Orbit (PLEO) Satellite-Based Services (SBS) IDIQ Continuous / Standing On-Ramp New Vendors Classification Code: DG10 � IT and Telecom � Satellite and RF Communications Services NAICS: 517410 � Satellite Telecommunications Contracting Activity: Department of the Air Force, Space Systems Command, Commercial Space Office (COMSO) Contracting Requirement Owner: Commercial Satellite Communications Office (CSCO) Notice Type: Pre-Solicitation Notice / Advance Notice of On-Ramp Solicitation Original Master Contract Solicitation: HC101322R0005 DISA/DITCO On-Ramp Solicitation Number: TBD PURPOSE & 30-DAY ADVANCE NOTICE REQUIREMENT 1. Mandatory 30-Day Pre-Solicitation Notice: This announcement constitutes the official Department of the Air Force, Space Systems Command (SSC) advance pre-solicitation notification for an upcoming contract on-ramp event under the Proliferated Low Earth Orbit (PLEO) Satellite-Based Services (SBS) Multiple-Award Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract suite. In compliance with the overarching PLEO SBS Performance Work Statement (PWS) On-Ramping clause, which mandates that �in the event the Government elects to conduct a contract on-ramp event, the Government will advertise a minimum of 30 days in advance of posting the formal solicitation�, this notice serves as the required 30-day public advertisement prior to the formal issuance of the competitive onramp Solicitation. 2. Open-Ended/Continuous On-Ramp Structure: Industry is advised that the forthcoming solicitation will be issued as a standing, continuous open solicitation. Unlike a traditional single-closing solicitation, the onramp solicitation will remain open for proposal submissions through the end of the master IDIQ base ordering period (17 July 2028). The Government intends to evaluate proposals in periodic, structured cohorts as defined in the solicitation, ensuring continuous access to emerging commercial space-based solutions within the scope of the PWS while maintaining orderly evaluation procedures. 3. Release of Draft Performance Work Statement (PWS): To afford industry adequate time to prepare for the upcoming solicitation, the Government has included a draft PWS. Industry is invited to view the baseline operational scope, service descriptions, and technical framework. 4. Nature of Notice: This notice is for informational, planning, and pre-solicitation compliance purposes. It does not constitute a formal Request for Proposals (RFP), an Invitation for Bids (IFB), or an obligation on the part of the Government to acquire any products or services. The Government is not seeking any responses to this notice. The Government will not reimburse any interested party for any information, administrative costs, or preparation efforts submitted in response to this notice or the included PWS. PROGRAM CONSTRAINTS & ON-RAMP PARAMETERS Potential Offerors must take note of the non-negotiable program constraints governing this on-ramp event: 1. Unchanged Program Ceiling: The overarching maximum programmatic ordering ceiling for the PLEO SBS IDIQ suite was established under original solicitation HC101322R0005 at $13B. In accordance with base contract terms, the on-ramp event will not increase or alter the ceiling. Newly awarded contractors will share the remaining programmatic ordering capacity alongside the existing awardees. 2. Co-Terminus Ordering Period: The ordering periods established under the original master contract suite remain unchanged. The base ordering period expires 17 July 2028, followed by an optional ordering period running through 17 July 2023 (plus RFO 52.217-8 extension through 17 January 2034). Any contracts awarded as a result of this on-ramp will be strictly co-terminus with the existing IDIQ awards. 3. Continuous Submission Window & Scheduled Evaluation Gates: Following solicitation release, eligible offerors may submit proposals at any time prior to the final solicitation closing date of 17 July 2028. To ensure disciplined configuration control, submitted proposals may be batched and evaluated against scheduled, periodic evaluation cut-off dates which will be specified in Section L of the solicitation. 4. Evaluation Parity: Consistent with base contract terms, proposals submitted under the forthcoming on-ramp solicitation are likely to be subject to similar evaluation procedures, documentation, and criteria as applied during the original competition, updated to reflect changes in regulatory provisions, statutory cybersecurity requirements, and commercial practices. 6. Re-submission Limitations: Offerors whose proposals are evaluated and determined technically unacceptable may be subject to a cooling-off period as outlined in the solicitation prior to becoming eligible to resubmit a revised proposal under a later evaluation batch. Commercial Space-Based Data Transport Services: Advanced commercial space� to-ground and satellite-enable telecommunications transport architectures operating within the low Earth orbit regimes. 2. Resilient Managed Satellite Network Services: Highly resilient, multi-band, and managed space communications services compliant with current Department of War and federal cybersecurity, supply chain risk management, and licensing requirements. description: 1. DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENT This is a Solicitation Synopsis issued by the Department of the Air Force, Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center (AFNWC/NIKM), Hill AFB, UT. This solicitation is for the production and delivery of flight test kit replenishment spares for the Flight Test, Telemetry, and Termination (FT3) Program. These kits directly support the Air Force Global Strike Command (AFGSC) Minuteman III (MMIII) Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Force Development Evaluation Operational Test Launch (OTL) Program. 2. SOLE-SOURCE JUSTIFICATION The Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source: The Boeing Company (CAGE: 0B0D7), located in Layton, UT, under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by RFO 6.103-1 (Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements). Market research, including a Sources Sought Synopsis (FA8214-25S-FT3PD) and Pre-solicitation Notice (FA821426RB004-PRESOL), concluded that Boeing is the only source with the unique technical data, specialized engineering expertise, and established manufacturing infrastructure required to meet the Government's strict performance schedules. Award to any other source would result in an estimated minimum duplication of $80M in costs and an unacceptable delay of at least three (3) years. 3. PROGRAM SCOPE & REQUIREMENTS The resulting contract is anticipated to be a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) vehicle containing the following primary parameters: Quantity: Production and delivery of twenty-five (25) FT3 flight test kits. Delivery Schedule: Just-in-time delivery to Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA, precisely 120 days prior to scheduled Operational Test Launches (OTLs). Period of Performance: October 2027 through September 2035. Total Estimated Program Value: Approximately $955M (including potential future procurements executed under an approved Class J&A). 4. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS & INTEREST This notice is not a request for competitive proposals, and a written solicitation will be issued directly to The Boeing Company. However, any responsible source that believes it can meet these requirements may submit a capability statement, proposal, or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency. Information received will be evaluated solely to determine whether to conduct a competitive procurement in the future. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. All responses must be submitted electronically to the Points of Contact listed below no later than the Response Deadline indicated in this posting.

title: Czechia – Construction work – D46 MÚK Držovice
description: Předmětem zakázky je rekonstrukce mimoúrovňové křižovatky MÚK Držovice na silnici D46 (E462), která v současném stavu nevyhovuje platným technickým normám ani požadavkům na bezpečný a plynulý provoz. Stávající mostní objekt ev. č. 46–014B je ve zhoršeném technickém stavu a vyžaduje nahrazení novou konstrukcí. Současně je nevyhovující uspořádání křižovatky z hlediska kapacity a bezpečnosti provozu. Realizací stavby dojde k přestavbě křižovatky, doplnění připojovacích a odbočovacích pruhů a úpravě dopravního řešení včetně napojení na okolní komunikační síť. Součástí je také vybudování nové okružní křižovatky na ulici Konečná. Cílem zakázky je zvýšení bezpečnosti silničního provozu, zlepšení plynulosti dopravy a zajištění dlouhodobě vyhovujícího technického stavu dopravní infrastruktury na silnici D46.

De dienstverlening richt zich op medewerkers van de Rechtspraak die vanwege hun functie of omstandigheden worden geconfronteerd met een verhoogd veiligheidsrisico. De opdrachtnemer moet niet alleen beveiligingsmaatregelen kunnen adviseren, leveren en onderhouden, maar ook zorgen voor monitoring, alarmopvolging, begeleiding, advies, coördinatie en ‘speciale diensten’ gedurende de gehele looptijd van een beveiligingstraject. De geraamde waarde van de Opdracht bedraagt gemiddeld € 800.000, -- exclusief btw per jaar, derhalve €4.000.000,-- exclusief btw over een looptijd van 5 jaar. Om te voorkomen dat de contractuele maximumwaarde tussentijds wordt overschreden en de raamovereenkomst voor het beoogde einde van de looptijd haar effect zou verliezen, sluiten we de raamovereenkomst af met een maximale opdrachtwaarde van € 6.000.000,--exclusief btw.

title: France – Beach cleaning services – ENTRETIEN DES PLAGES ET DU LITTORAL
description: ***Le présent marché a pour objet, l'entretien des plages et du littoral de la commune de Roquebrune-sur-Argens et leur maintien en parfait état de propreté. Toutes les prestations du présent marché pourront être commandées à tout moment. L'entreprise devra mettre en oeuvre tous les moyens nécessaires à la réalisation des prestations suivantes : - Nettoiement des plages et du littoral : Cette opération comprend le nettoiement manuel des plages (de sables ou de galets), des criques, des ouvrages piétonniers divers (chemin des douanier, sentier, accès, mises à l'eau et autres cheminements), des grèves rocheuses, des ouvrages de protection des plages (talus, épis, sorties pluviaux...), ainsi que l'ensemble des secteurs se rattachant au périmètre défini au CCTP entre les limites de communes de Fréjus et Sainte Maxime. - Collecte des poubelles de plages et du littoral : Cette opération consiste à collecter les poubelles mises en place sur les plages, le long de la RD559 et du littoral Sambracitain (côté mer). - Le criblage des plages de sable : Cette opération comprend le nettoiement mécanique des plages de sable et des criques de sable se rattachant au périmètre défini à l'article 1.3.1. du CCTP. Cette prestation inclut la collecte et l'évacuation en décharge de tous déchets, détritus ou autres matières. - Le reprofilage ponctuel des plages et de leur accès à effectuer avant la période estivale et après les coups de mer ou fortes pluies (sorties de ruisseaux et pluviaux). - Gestion de la posidonie : Cette opération est à effectuer avant la période estivale et selon les besoins. En accord avec les préconisations environnementales, la posidonie sera déplacée sur la même plage, et stockée, par couches alternées posidonie/sable. - Gestion du volume de sable : Cette opération est à prévoir en amont de la saison et en fin de saison, le principe étant de constituer une réserve de sable en fin de saison qui permettra lors de la saison suivante " d'engraisser " les plages concernées. - Concassage des plages : Cette opération sera planifiée en amont de chaque saison en fonction des nécessités, afin d'améliorer la granulométrie du sable.

title: Netherlands – Endangered species protection services – Telemetrieonderzoek ruige dwergvleermuis In relatie tot offshore windparken
description: Het doel van deze opdracht is om meer inzicht te krijgen in de migratieroutes, het trekgedrag en het gebruik van het Noordzeegebied door de ruige dwergvleermuis. Hiervoor worden vleermuizen gezenderd en gevolgd via het MOTUS-netwerk, aangevuld met DNA-onderzoek. De resultaten moeten bijdragen aan een betere beoordeling van de effecten van windparken op zee op populatieniveau. Daarnaast moeten de gegevens inzicht geven in vliegroutes, vlieghoogtes en trekmomenten, zodat mitigerende maatregelen, zoals het tijdelijk stilzetten van windturbines, effectiever kunnen worden ingezet. Ook is ruimte voor aanvullende analyses en innovatieve onderzoekstechnieken, mits deze aantoonbaar bijdragen aan het verkleinen van bestaande kennisleemten. 4 jaar + 2 x 1 jaar optie tot verlenging

description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe eines Mandats für die Gesamtleitung (GL) für die Mittelfristmassnahmen Thunstrasse West und Ost über die SIA-Phasen 32 bis 53. Die GL übernimmt im Auftrag von Tiefbau Stadt Bern die operative Führung und stellt die zielgerichtete Umsetzung der Projektziele von der Phase Bauprojekt bis zum Projektabschluss sicher. Die GL übernimmt die integrale Führung und Koordination des Planerteams und stellt die Abstimmung mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen und Projektbeteiligten sicher. Sie koordiniert insbesondere die Bereiche Strassenbau, Werkleitungsplanung und -bau, Verkehr und Landschaftsarchitektur sowie die relevanten Schnittstellen zu Drittprojekten und angrenzenden Infrastrukturen. Dabei berücksichtigt sie die besonderen Anforderungen des innerstädtischen und hochfrequentierten Projektperimeters und unterstützt die Bauherrschaft bei der Vorbereitung und Begleitung von fachlichen, organisatorischen, rechtlichen und politischen Entscheiden. Die detaillierten geforderten Aufgaben und Leistungen der GL gemäss SIA 103 sind im Leistungsbeschrieb (vgl. Anhang 1) und in der Leistungstabelle (vgl. Anhang 2) genauer erläutert. Das Mandat der Verkehrsplanung und Landschaftsarchitektur ist im Mandat der GL (Teil der Ausschreibung Gesamtleitung) integriert. Sämtliche notwendigen Planer*innen sowie auch Landschaftsarchitekt*innen und Verkehrsplaner*innen sind der GL organisatorisch und fachlich unterstellt.

title: Czechia – Network equipment – Rozšíření a podpora DWDM
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je povinnost dodavatele dodat a následně implementovat technické a programové prostředky pro rozšíření stávajících DWDM zařízení a poskytovat k nim a ke stávajícím technickým a programovým prostředkům služby podpory. Bližší specifikace předmětu veřejné zakázky je uvedena v návrhu smlouvy, který tvoří přílohu č. 1 zadávací dokumentace. Vzhledem ke skutečnosti, že zadavatel má plně integrovány stávající HW a SW prostředky DWDM ve své IS struktuře a rozšíření přenosové kapacity mezi lokalitami o 100 Gb nelze z důvodu kompatibility provést jinak než za užití prostředků, které jsou předmětem této zakázky, a přechod na jiné HW a SW prostředky by s sebou nesl nepřiměřeně vysoké náklady na straně zadavatele, ať již při pořízení zcela nových DWDM zařízení (míněno i za stávající prostředky, u nichž výměna není potřebná), či při nezbytné úpravě všech stávajících aplikací a systémů, které tyto prostředky užívají, má zadavatel za to, že je v tomto případě odůvodněno samotným předmětem veřejné zakázky odkazování na konkrétní výrobek, resp. na HW a SW prostředky a podporu konkrétního výrobce, jehož pořízení je předmětem této veřejné zakázky. Zadavatel nepřistoupil k rozdělení veřejné zakázky na části, neboť předmět veřejné zakázky tvoří jeden funkční celek a je zadáván v časové souvislosti. Zadavatel je při zadání veřejné zakázky v postavení poskytovatele regulované služby, a to v režimu vyšších povinností ve smyslu zákona č. 264/2025 Sb., o kybernetické bezpečnosti, v platném znění, a jeho prováděcích předpisů, kdy tato skutečnost je zohledněna zadavatelem v zadávacích podmínkách této veřejné zakázky.
